title: The Long Night
summary: Early February, -40 C, blizzard. Kit's sled, the column leaves Sector 4 on a rope line down the frozen Truckee; the Remnant picket at the Glendale bridge; whiteout voices (a Hollow in Walt's voice) and a silent assimilated pack; the ice breaks; Tallmen test the column (Wraith's hold); Salt's culvert and Walt on the sled at Steamboat Creek; Wraith leads through the whiteout to Galena's gate.

horror.notes: Whiteout: 15 m sightline, rope line is the only safe path; Hollows and Tallmen wake only below visibilityM.
horror.binding: Spawns tagged ambush=true + lowVisibilityTrigger=true stay dormant (no AI tick, hidden) until the player is inside the ambush point radius AND visibility (ash, fog, darkness, flashlight off) is below environment.visibilityM, or the point's lightFlicker drops out. Hollows (assimilated_human / assimilated_animal) never render a breath plume; living NPCs always do (story assimilation.tells).
